_source: Faithful transcription of pototype/chrome.jsx NAV (lines 98-239) — the label/icon/grouping layer that routes/registry.ts deliberately omits (P0-WEB-05). Route ids here are cross-checked 1:1 against SIDEBAR_ROUTES in nav-tree.test.ts. Thai label strings ARE the nav_i18n keys (tn()); Thai is allowed in .json (i18n-guard skips .json/.md). Badge counts are C10 mock mechanics: 'badge' holds the count-source route id, NEVER the hardcoded number (chrome.jsx 4/17/8/5/12/6) — the count comes from a real query (none exists yet: BLOCKERS B-039).
